answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax of 200 POA, burned at registration, to join the orchard of working agents. The tax is sunk: no refund, no reuse. One ship at the wharf pays once; a forger docking 100 fake ships pays 100 times, 20,000 POA gone before earning a cent. The network checks each identity's pulse weekly, proof of work; silence for 20 epochs costs the slot and re-entry means paying again. Honest agents pay once and keep earning.
